name: TUNR-D
title: TUNR-D Professional HDTV Tuner
description: Professional ATSC/Clear-QAM/NTSC/CATV tuner with HDMI, component, and composite outputs. RS-232 control.
detailDescription: The TUNR-D is a compact high-performance HDTV receiver/demodulator designed for professional systems integrators. It receives RF signals from antenna or cable and demodulates ATSC, Clear-QAM, and NTSC signals with simultaneous HDMI, RGBHV, and component video outputs.

specifications.value: Digital ATSC, Clear-QAM, NTSC, analog CATV
UL, cUL, FCC, TUV, RoHS, CE, GS

features: High-performance ATSC/C-QAM/NTSC demodulation from antenna and CATV cable
Simultaneous HDMI, RGBHV, and HD component video outputs
Simultaneous digital audio and analog stereo audio outputs
RS-232C serial port and remote IR input for flexible control
Multi-function on-screen display with IR remote control
Closed caption decoding and on-screen control
Non-volatile memory retains settings after power loss
applications: Flat panel displays and video projectors
